about:
Design Warehouse has operated as a Santa Fe, New Mexico retail destination since 1981. Located at 130 Lincoln Avenue, the store has served as a long-standing source for contemporary furniture, lighting, and home accessories. The business remains independently owned, though no founder names are disclosed in public records.

The company operates a brick-and-mortar showroom offering a curated selection of furniture, lamps, and home accessories. Its product range includes wardrobe systems such as the Garden Party line in Oblivion and White finishes. The business ships orders via USPS Ground for smaller items and common carrier for larger furniture pieces, with shipping costs tiered by order value: $10 for orders up to $49, $20 for orders $50–$99, and free shipping on orders over $100. All web orders and furniture sales are final.

The store serves residential customers in the Santa Fe area and ships to the other 47 states. Its clientele includes local residents and out-of-state buyers seeking contemporary home furnishings. A 2019 review in Local Flavor Magazine described the showroom as "the place in town to come for the most beautiful, artfully designed furniture, lamps and home accessories."

Design Warehouse emphasizes personal service, encouraging customers to call for quotes and support. The company validates free parking for one hour at its off-site lot and maintains a phone-first approach to customer communication.
